fields.question: Do you deliver furniture to my area?
fields.answer: Yes – we deliver nationwide with careful transport and professional assembly. Call us and we will confirm the delivery options and fee for your location.

fields.question: How is my furniture delivered?
fields.answer: Your furniture is wrapped and protected during transport, then moved into your home and assembled by our team. You do not have to lift a finger.

fields.question: How much does delivery cost?
fields.answer: The delivery fee depends on the distance and the size of the order. We always confirm the exact fee before you place your order – no surprises.

fields.question: Can I order a custom size or finish?
fields.answer: Absolutely. We regularly make custom pieces – different sizes, wood finishes, colors and materials. Share your measurements or a reference photo with us and we will quote you.

fields.question: How do I order a custom piece?
fields.answer: Simply call us or visit the showroom with your requirements (measurements, style, finish). We will confirm the design, materials and price before we start.

fields.question: How long does a custom piece take?
fields.answer: Custom furniture usually takes 7–20 days depending on the complexity of the design and our current production schedule.

fields.question: What payment methods do you accept?
fields.answer: We accept cash and bank transfer. For custom-made and order-made items, a small deposit secures your order and the balance is paid upon delivery.

fields.question: Do I need to pay the full amount in advance?
fields.answer: No. For in-stock items you can pay on delivery. For made-to-order pieces we ask for a small deposit, with the balance due when your furniture arrives.

fields.question: Do you offer installments?
fields.answer: We can discuss flexible payment arrangements when you call – we will find a solution that works for you.

fields.question: How can I reach SALAAR's HOME?
fields.answer: The fastest way is a phone call at 037 080 4453. You can also message us on Facebook or TikTok – links are in the footer.

fields.question: What are your opening hours?
fields.answer: We are open every day from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM. You are welcome to visit the showroom anytime during these hours.

fields.question: Can I visit the showroom?
fields.answer: Of course – we love showing our furniture in person. Visit us during opening hours, and for a smoother experience call us before you come.

fields.question: How long until I receive my furniture?
fields.answer: In-stock pieces are typically delivered within 1–3 days. Made-to-order and custom pieces take around 7–20 days, depending on the design.

fields.question: Can I choose a delivery date?
fields.answer: Yes – when you place your order we will agree on a delivery day and time that suits you.

fields.question: Does my furniture come with a warranty?
fields.answer: Yes. Our furniture is covered by a structural warranty, and our team stands behind the quality of every piece we sell.

fields.question: What does the warranty cover?
fields.answer: Manufacturing defects in the frame and structure are covered. If anything is wrong with the workmanship, we will repair or replace it free of charge.

fields.question: What about after-sales care?
fields.answer: We remain available after your purchase – for care advice, small repairs or guidance on keeping your wood furniture beautiful for years.
